desc: The Hypa-Lite™ Punisher™ Sling is a shotgun sling designed with the waterfowler in mind. The gun sling begins with ultra-durable and lightweight hypalon construction with molded, low-density foam and a non-slip backing. The front of the gun sling features Realtree MAX-5 camo in quiet fabric, plus a spare call storage pocket and two extra shell loops. The body of the shoulder pad is 14? long by 3.25? wide, and the adjustable web sling is 1? wide. Includes D-rings to attach accessories, an adjustable ladder lock buckle and swivels tested up to 300 pounds
